display_name: Hybrid 失败种子隔离视图与样本轨迹
description: 五配置、13 个已曝光测试落后种子，每种子比较伪类别对比和同信号正对两种辅助方式。
authorization: 2026-11-13 用户将优化目标更改为 Hybrid，要求所有通过置信度的伪标签参与辅助训练。

code.commit: actual committed release identity in runtime.json

data.dataset: receiver split 2, ten-class, 1%- and 5%-labeled, six-source-receiver original full-source roles

roles.L_s: complete original labeled role for each configuration

data.train_ratio: original per-configuration roles; no source holdout
data.validation_ref: existing data roles; Phase2 capsule not applicable
data.support_query_ref: per-row frozen seven-view prediction then independent truth-last scoring
data.leo_config_ref: original six practical scenario views, identical physical IDs per matched row

permissions.query_use: frozen direct prediction then independent truth-last
permissions.claim_scope: previously exposed target selected these settings and seeds; exploratory only, never checkpoint selection

checkpoint.initialization: same-setting same-seed original full-L Tri E20, then own E10+E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: matching original full-source same-seed E20; no held-out L or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed E50 for each preselected row; test-selected failing seeds are exploratory

execution.gpu_policy: single shared owner; GPU 7 total max 4 and other cards max 6, includes other users and memory reservations
execution.stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch for the affected queue; preserve other healthy workers and outputs

expected_artifacts: real-checkpoint no-query smoke per setting and auxiliary mode
26 direct seven-view predictions and independent truth-last scores
source U per-exposure compressed packet trace and 50-step auxiliary gradient diagnostics
matched ordinary PL and original Hybrid for each selected seed

notes: Original Hybrid vs matched ordinary PL determines failing configurations and seeds by clean or six-scene mean; test already exposed, no population-average inference.
All confident source U receive an isolated constant-strength 0.1 auxiliary view; standard U uses its original ordinary/raw partition.
Compare pseudo-class-aware packet contrast with same-packet positive-only cosine; no U true labels are read.
Each U exposure records base_index, source RX/day, confidence, pseudo-label, acceptance, auxiliary-view predictions and auxiliary loss; gradient dot/norm every 50 steps.
Use own shared scheduler with existing low-weight queue and preserve all healthy workers.
